---
description: Execute the approved Angular modernization plan and verify each gate.
---

Execute the approved Angular Order Service plan and task graph in order.
Preserve the simulated API contract and all user-visible behavior. Use
official Angular migrations where applicable; review their changes rather
than assuming they are complete. Stop on a failed prerequisite or validation
gate, report the failure and do not mark dependent tasks complete.

After each stage run the tests and production build, record results and
deviations, and provide a final summary suitable for independent review.
